Services

What the body shop does

The services from the shop’s own Facebook page, as customers describe them on Google.

Car painting

From a single bumper to a full respray. Reviews mention exact colour matching and even factory matte paint.

Body repairs and dents

Accident damage, dented doors, cracked bumpers. One customer writes that the door was repaired where others wanted to replace it.

Polishing and scratches

Scratches removed and headlights polished. Two reviews come from visitors who had a scratch on a rental car fixed before returning it.

Alloy refurbishment

Wheels refinished in the spray booth, as listed on the shop’s Facebook page and shown in its photos.

How a repair goes

Insurance handled

Fair prices

A body shop in Yeroskipou

R.A Car Paint & Body Repairs Ltd works in Yeroskipou, just outside Paphos, with its own spray booth. Its Facebook page lists car painting, body repairs, dent removal, polishing and alloy refurbishment, and says insurance work is welcome. Customers write their Google reviews in English and German, and the owner answers many of them.

What customers say

Three of 134 Google reviews, 129 of them with five stars.

“I had my bumper repainted here and am very happy with the result. From the beginning, the owner was professional, knowledgeable, and honest about what needed to be done. He explained the process clearly and was easy to communicate with throughout.”

Google review
“Highly recommend this professional body repair shop. Always replied to my messages, job completed on time, he sorted out all insurance matters & charged reasonable prices for any extra work. And finally, the quality of his work is flawless.”

Google review
